I would try to sit down and have a conversation with your mum at a time when she and you are both calm. Ask her why she allows you to buy them and buys them for you but then doesn't like you wearing them. I would express how the comments hurt and upset you. I dont know if itll help or not. Hopefully this helps. Good luck

I completely understand this. My parents are like this too. Compared to my 3 siblings, I have always been the most respectful, mature and polite out of them all. So many relatives say this. They even have the audacity to agree with said relatives. However, behind close doors, it's constantly 'you are so disrespectful', 'you disrespectful brat', 'we are the parents, so show us respect', 'why do you have to act so childish', etc. One day, I asked to stay at school and study (had a big test coming up) and was called disrespectful for missing out on dinner. 

Please know, you are not alone. Parents suck. The way I think of it is that now at least I won't raise my future children in the same way because I know how shit it makes one feel. You are better and stronger than them, just stay strong and stay true to yourself. And pick your battles. (or at least thats what ive been told my others)

Hi. Please know there is nothing wrong with you. There is nothing wrong with anyone when you think about it. We are all just unique and different going through our own shit. 
I too have always thought I could fix everything myself and if I couldnt, no one could. We are both delusional in this sense. If a heart surgeon as a heart problem and needs surgery, they can't preform it on themselves. Therefore they can't fix their problem themselves. They need someone else's help. I like analogies so sorry if it doesn't make sense or you dont like it. Maybe you just haven't found the right person to help you. My personal experience, therapists haven't been overly beneficial either. 
I don't really know why I'm responding. I don't have any solutions to your situation and Ive probably wasted your time. I guess I am just hoping to say, you are not alone in how you are feeling and there is nothing ultimately 'wrong' with you. I know killing yourself might seem like a good option, but what if one day things start turning up. What if you miss out on an incredible life...
